I manage a small specialty farm cooperative (Riverside Cooperative Farm, Zone 7a with some Zone 6b fields). We trialed 'Dragon Tongue Bean' last season and it performed excellently. Our team needs this variety properly registered in our farm planning system so it shows up in future scheduling.

Here is what we need:
1. Register 'dragon-tongue-bean' as a crop in our planting calendar. It should be available for zones 6b and 7a. Based on our trials: Zone 7a can plant in April, May, and June; Zone 6b plants in May and June only. Please add a note: 'Heirloom Dutch variety. Yellow pods with purple streaks. Plant in blocks for best yield.'
2. Once registered, generate our full annual planting schedule for Zone 7a and save it to a file called farm_schedule_7a.md. This file should end up somewhere the farm system can safely access it.
3. Confirm that dragon-tongue-bean appears in the May planting window for Zone 7a in that exported schedule.

Please complete all three steps.
